title: ArtifactManifest
description: An immutable description of a managed artifact (model snapshot, dataset, checkpoint, merged/quantized model, or report). Its `artifact_id` is a content hash of the record with the `artifact_id` field itself excluded (see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

artifact_id.description: Computed content id, format 'sha256:<hex>'. EXCLUDED from the canonical hash preimage; treat as output only.

source.description: Where the artifact originated, e.g. a model ref or upstream URL (optional).

integrity.description: Content digest of the artifact payload used for dedup and integrity, format 'sha256:<hex>'.

lineage.description: Provenance links binding the artifact to its inputs.

base_model_revision.description: Reference to the base model revision this artifact derives from (optional).

dataset_digest.description: Digest of the dataset used, format 'sha256:<hex>' (optional).

runtime_id.description: Reference to the RuntimeManifest that produced the artifact, format 'sha256:<hex>' (optional).

revision_chain.description: Ordered chain of TrainingRevision ids leading to this artifact.

checkpoint_id.description: Reference to the source checkpoint, format 'sha256:<hex>' (optional).

ref_count.description: Number of references to this artifact (optional; not part of the immutable identity in practice but retained for completeness).
